主要内容: Nicholas Financial, Inc. (NASDAQ: NICK) reported a 27% increase in net earnings to $6,045,000 for the three months ended March 31, 2012, compared to $4,772,000 for the same period in 2011. Diluted net earnings per share rose 25% to $0.50, up from $0.40 in the prior year period. The company also saw a 7% increase in revenue to $17,182,000, compared to $16,095,000 for the same period in 2011. The report was filed with the SEC on May 2, 2012.
